lines: Why do my order totals drift by a cent?

items.text: Rounding each line before adding them up.
Rounding half up, so every tie goes the same way.

text: Round once, on the total, and round half to even:

let total = round_half_even(subtotal + tax);
assert_eq!(total, Money::from_cents(7_384));
That keeps the total a customer sees equal to the total that settles.
